architectures.two_standard_d3: Two independent copies; 1344 total CX and 30 crossing CX. This is not a resource-normalized comparison.

ci_method: Pointwise 95% Wilson; standard pair uses monotone-transformed endpoints. Original standard source Clopper-Pearson intervals retained in source_data but not used in this figure.
correlated_data_status: Retained in CSV for transparency but not plotted. The saved standard-d3 correlation-aware decoder miscorrects 15 of 2536 raw single-fault mechanisms at each of the ten noise probabilities; see reference_audit.json.
metric: decoded target-Z readout failure per complete experiment
primary_decoder: standard PyMatching for both architectures; both pass all checked raw single-fault decoder tests
scope: Target-Z readout comparison of the shared-ancilla dual-LCNOT simulation and the two-independent-LCNOT reference, with circuits initialized in the logical zero state.
standard_pair_assumption: Two identical independent standard-d3 executions, with no shared noise or hardware faults.
standard_pair_estimator: 2*q-q^2, with q the measured single standard-d3 target-Z LER
